'''2007 US East Nationals Day 2 Tim Simon DS Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Tim Simon]] at [[2007 US East Nationals]] (Day 2).

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi / Their Fire Has Gone Out Of The Universe|SE-D-huntdownanddestroythejedi.gif}}
* '''Deck name:''' That's A Mighty Fine Gin and Tonic, Why Don't You Mix Me Up Another?
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS12]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
